purpose: Refer respectfully to someone’s presence or movement.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
いらっしゃる replaces いる, 行く, or 来る.
The teacher is in the office.
What time will you come tomorrow?
The company president is going to Osaka next week.
formation: いらっしゃる replaces いる, 行く, or 来る.
restrictions: Use for someone being honored, rather than your own action.
mistake: The same verb has three meanings; context identifies presence, arrival, or departure.
